value: GA3 at 50 and 500 mg/L shortened time-to-germination; the 1000 mg/L dose has no stated effect on time-to-germination in the abstract (0 mg/L was the control)
method: fully crossed seed germination experiment of light (white, red, darkness), photoperiod and GA3 at 0, 50, 500 and 1000 mg/L; penalized logistic regression and Cox proportional hazards models
conditions: laboratory trial; abstract reports that red light and darkness combined with GA3 raised the probability of germination, and that cotyledon and leaf growth showed no adverse effect of the treatments; the abstract states no result for the 1000 mg/L dose on timing and no per-dose germination percentages; seed source and replicate numbers not read (abstract only)

value: synthetic strigolactone GR24 raised germination (peak 46.7% against 16.4% in controls; significant only at 3, 10 and 15 mg/L) and sped it up; smoke-water cut germination to 2.9% overall against 16.44% in controls and slowed seedling growth
method: seeds germinated at 10 +/- 1 C, 16:8 h photoperiod (100-120 umol m-2 s-1 LED), sterile seawater at 30 PSU, 60 days; GR24 at ten concentrations from 0.5 to 25 mg/L and a smoke-water dilution series from 1:100 to 1:1 v:v against untreated controls; three independent trials
conditions: three seed lots from Hamburger Hallig, Wadden Sea, Germany (S 2021 sterilized and stored 15 months, S 2022 sterilized and stored 4 months, NS 2022 non-sterilized); 1,125 seeds in all; GR24 doses significant for germination only at 3 mg/L (40.0%), 10 mg/L (40.0%) and 15 mg/L (46.7%) in the S 2022 lot, no germination at 2 mg/L, and mean germination time not changed by GR24 overall (p = 0.40); smoke-water is a home-made herbal-blend karrikin-rich solution, karrikins not quantified; smoke-water reduced germination hazard by 89.64% (p = 0.03) on a limited sample the authors call possibly incomplete; paper's confidence intervals and a cotyledon figure are internally inconsistent

conditions: propagules from the Pichavaram mangrove forest, India; GA3 effects depended on light (Light x GA3 interaction significant for root length, F = 11.47, and leaf area, F = 7.04); GA3 had only a marginal effect on root length under light and generally better root growth under shade; salinity had no significant effect on root length or leaf area; the percentage figures are read from the paper's text for non-saline treatments
